items.definition: Native preparation/read/validation binds actual S1/S3/S4/S5 owners, one effect and one consumption. Exact tenant/principal, mandate, policy/branch, target, operation/dose/unit, refinements, source/preconditions, deadline, method and settlement survive concurrent delivery. Evidence E1. No remaining task.

Ordinary compiler → bounded typed IR → separate protected verifier checks exact original obligation, target/account/unit/body/version and independently signed method binding; substitutions are refused. Conditional JSON class only. E1/E2. No remaining task.

Signed nonce assessment of native identity/rights/mandate/policy/allocation/source/admission/expiry and live job/step fences is durably protected immediately before possible PATCH; its validity bounds the wire deadline. The remote acceptance race remains explicit. E1. No remaining task.

The candidate broker confines credentials and the actual Seatbelt worker denies network/private files/process creation, but a coherent obligation-bound delegation contract does not yet conserve parent rights, targets and budget. **Task:** bind existing child/delegated work to authenticated parent authority, exact permitted target/refinements and remaining S5 envelope; persist its responsibility; refuse unsupported delegation and prevent parent completion until required children settle. Reuse the existing child/workflow paths; no new subagent or executor domain. Aggregate resource enforcement is S6-13.

Fixed-route protected conditional JSON dispatch is qualified; ordinary provider/DB/artifact/browser/delegated paths are not all governed by that protected contract. **Task:** enforce a versioned admission/refusal matrix at the existing entry and physical-effect boundaries for network/provider, DB, filesystem/artifact, browser and delegated work. Require exact obligation-bound authority on admitted paths; block raw/redirect/alternate/credential/child escapes and refuse protected admission where confinement is unsupported. Do not claim existing trusted adapters are independently protected or admit new methods/providers.

Native governed scheduling exists; a complete common adapter contract and truthful compute provenance integration do not. **Task:** attach one versioned identity/authority/observation/retry/cancellation/recovery/resource contract to the existing adapters, connect execution inputs/outputs/attempts/runtime/route/resources/cost-or-gap to ModelComputeFabric provenance, and enforce that only already declared conforming classes can execute as protected obligations. Record unsupported classes explicitly; configuration cannot supply identity or deterministic replay.

Pre-egress intent/attempt, stale-claim fencing and single-member crash recovery pass. The broker's `attempts.length === 0` guard strands never-attempted members after partial delivery. **Task:** persist and recover progress per original member, resume only never-attempted members under fresh exact authority/admission/time/fences, never replay a possibly attempted member, and require all original members for parent settlement. Conserve the existing attempt/read bounds and cancellation semantics.

Possible delivery survives loss of claims, cancellation and crash; conditional JSON recovery performs GET only. Existing provider operation history and physical protection-window checks preserve ambiguous prior attempts. E1/E6. No automatic exactly-once or delayed-provider guarantee is claimed. No remaining task.

Exact account/record/field/value/null/version/operation readback gates protected settlement; wrong-record/null/empty/unsupported evidence cannot complete. Existing browser and artifact owning-boundary fixes preserve target identity. E1/E6. Partial-member liveness repair belongs to S6-07. No remaining task.

Genuine allocation-bound protected intent/attempt/observation evidence drives native S5 UNKNOWN/RECONCILED state; possible effects and full liabilities remain, costs are explicitly UNMETERED, release is false, and retries deduplicate. Cancellation does not erase exposure. Compensation requires a separately authorized linked effect. E1/E3. No remaining task.

Authenticated semantic-owner append, immutable identities/content/preimages/references, typed parents/order, concurrent retries, separate receipts, exact release/verifier/checkpoint binding, sealed access/encryption, tamper/truncate/SIGKILL recovery and actual writer exclusion are qualified locally. E2/E3/E4. Native producer wiring is S6-14–17; whole-state rollback is S6-11R. No remaining task.

Local signed journal/head cannot detect rollback of both protected state and journal; `health` explicitly reports a required external witness. **Task:** implement the pinned independent monotonic commitment/witness interface and verify history against it before dependent append/read/egress; enforce fail-closed outage/conflict handling with retained responsibility and recoverable receipts. Use existing ledger-integrity/crash challenges. Actual independently protected witness deployment is X1.

Protocol-3 queue/step/SIGKILL/scheduler recovery passes, but complete version handoff and bounded operator takeover of protected obligations are absent. **Task:** integrate exact immutable request/attempt/receipt compatibility across existing deployment/executor versions, authenticated operator takeover and existing child/scheduler recovery. Incompatible versions must refuse effect execution while retaining authenticated history and responsibility; takeover must not reset attempts, fences, budgets or unresolved members.

Durable 64-read recovery bound passes; S5 envelopes remain held. Hard aggregate executor quotas and S5 execution/recovery/human charging are incomplete. **Task:** reserve/check/conserve the existing S5 resource units before execution, recovery and authenticated human intervention; retain unknown cost/liability explicitly. Enforce the declared worker CPU/memory/process-thread/disk/wall/output limits with available substrate controls, and refuse admission when a required bound cannot be enforced. Record actual usage or an explicit metering gap; do not invent billing or build a hypervisor. Production substrate qualification is X1.

S1 canonical belief joins work; original prepared S1 events are not durably issued through the owner outbox. **Task:** connect actual S1 belief/invalidation producers to authenticated immutable origins, original canonical reference preimages and durable protected delivery/readback, preserving original uncertainty/false admission/receipt fields and history.

Typed consumer envelope readback passes; synthetic metadata is not a native design integration. **Task:** wire actual S2 design/invalidation/realized producers and genuine owner-issued references/parent handoffs into that durable authenticated transport; preserve protocol digest semantics and scientific qualification. Resolve legitimate cross-episode prepared-parent transport without weakening causal parent authorization.

S3 prepared events currently remain immutable ordinary files. **Task:** add authenticated durable origin/delivery for actual S3 model, validity, prediction/realization and rejection records and their original references/parents, without changing S3 identification/admission ownership or manufacturing stronger evidence.

S4 canonical timing/handoff is integrated; prepared event files lack protected owner delivery. **Task:** wire actual S4 policy/revision/invalidation/observation/override/choice/handoff/rejection records and exact original references/parents into durable authenticated transport. Preserve S4 timing and S5 release ownership; an override cannot self-grant authority.

Actual S5 resources/problems/certificates/reservations/consumptions plus revision/invalidation events receive separate immutable signed origins and durable transport; settlement authenticates protected S6 causal history and retains liabilities. E1/E3. Missing foreign preimages refuse append rather than invent references. No remaining implementation task; final dependency replay is S6-21.

Typed protected readback exists, but the exact S6-owned downstream handoff is incomplete. **Task:** expose/version the authenticated attempts, exposure, observations, settlement, costs/gaps, immutable references and exact admission/release/evaluator-access evidence for downstream semantic consumers, with attenuated read authority and H0/H1/H2 qualifications. Connect available actual consumers without relabeling legacy learning as frozen S7/S8; absent semantic owners are X4.

items.requirement: Minimal Ring-0 / reviewed release / inherited trust
items.definition: Separate candidate verifier/broker/ledger and exact signed version checks exist; the full independently reviewable release package does not. **Task:** assemble the exact source/runtime/native dependency/policy/key/substrate/evaluator/witness/admission manifests, installation and compatibility/refusal procedures, and evidence for the eight minimal mechanisms below. Keep planners/compiler/models/economics/storage engines/projections/queries/learning/ordinary executors outside protected semantic authority. No self-issued production promotion or trust-rule release. Actual independent authority is X2.

items.requirement: Completion-gate evidence and final existing corpus
items.definition: Individual current owner suites pass; the complete corpus/checks/final review is not current on one final source. **Task:** after all other repository items pass, run the frozen existing corpus below, reconcile retained failures and exact source/runtime/baseline/fault/readback/receipt/model/resource evidence, complete solo falsification review, repair only defects of these frozen items, and record repository closure. No new challenge families, weakened oracle, expanded domain or economic multiplier claim.

Eight scopes, five contracts, H0/H1/H2, S1–S5 semantic ownership and S7 attribution remain explicit. Operational improvements do not certify 100×, Muse/dots 10× or frontier dominance. Unmeasured comparators remain unmeasured. No remaining task.

items.requirement: Independent production isolation / monotonic witness / protected custody
items.definition: Actual protected OS/service identity/key custody and nonrollbackable witness deployment are not supplied by local same-UID tests. S6-owned integration and reviewable artifacts must first be completed under S6-04/05/11R/13/20; this row does not excuse them.

items.requirement: Independent S8 admission and human-controlled protected release
items.definition: Production promotion and protected semantic release require actual independent admission/reviewer authority. Disposable test signers are not that authority. Prepare everything under S6-20 before any release approval request.

Available recorded provider execution is local TLS/contract-fixture evidence. The actual authorized live/staging provider contract, access and independent target readback are required for corresponding external claims. Do not reinterpret local transcripts as live evidence.

Their causal attribution/capability evolution implementations are owned by subsequent frozen scopes and are absent here. Complete the S6-owned typed/authorized handoff under S6-19; do not implement or rename those scopes within S6.

closureRule: All repository-controlled items PASS, then existing final corpus PASS. Report repository S6 closure separately from externally blocked full production gate; publish coherent Scopes 1–6 PRs only afterwards.
